audit_result.proof_trace: Property claims broadcasts only occur on subscribed subnets. The code iterates over custody columns and broadcasts each, but line 154 passes sidecar.Index (column index) directly as the subnet parameter instead of computing the subnet via peerdas.ComputeSubnetForDataColumnSidecar(). This works on mainnet where subnets==columns (both 128), but violates the property on configurations where they differ.
audit_result.attack_scenario: On a network with fewer subnets than columns (e.g., 64 subnets for 128 columns), a node would attempt to broadcast data columns on subnet IDs that equal high column indices (64-127), which are not valid subnet IDs and not subscribed, causing broadcast failures or publishing to unintended topics.

PROP-6a4369e9-inv-036.text: Publishing data columns must only occur on subnets the node is subscribed to (custody/sampling).
PROP-6a4369e9-inv-036.assertion: forall col: published(col, subnet) => subscribed(subnet, custody) || subscribed(subnet, sampling)

audit_result.proof_trace: The cache key omits KzgCommitments (the data being proven), including only the inclusion proof and header hash. Two data columns with identical proofs/headers but different commitments produce the same cache key, causing the second to skip verification and reuse the first's cached result.
audit_result.attack_scenario: Attacker sends valid DataColumnSidecar A, then sends forged DataColumnSidecar M with same inclusion proof and header but malicious KzgCommitments. Cache lookup succeeds on M's key, bypassing full Merkle verification and accepting invalid commitments.

PROP-6a4369e9-inv-042.text: Any cached/optimized inclusion proof verification must match full Merkle branch verification.

audit_result.proof_trace: ELMemPoolRequirements is empty (verification/blob.go:77), so KZG proof verification (RequireSidecarKzgProofVerified) is skipped. GetBlobsV2 path (L714) bypasses verification entirely via NewVerifiedRODataColumn. Trust assumption contradicts semi-trusted property requirement.
audit_result.attack_scenario: Compromised EL sends blobs with invalid KZG proofs via GetBlobsV1/V2. CL accepts without cryptographic verification and propagates them as verified, corrupting network consensus with invalid blob data.

PROP-57888860-asm-003.text: Engine API blob data is semi-trusted; blobs from EL must still pass KZG commitment verification.
PROP-57888860-asm-003.assertion: forall blob from EL: verify_blob_kzg_proof(blob, commitment) == true before propagation

audit_result.proof_trace: Storage contains data columns verified via RPC by_root (ByRootRequestDataColumnSidecarRequirements: 3 checks) mixed with gossip-validated columns (GossipDataColumnSidecarRequirements: 12 checks). RPC by_root handler serves from storage without re-validating gossip requirements, potentially serving columns for blocks that fail proposer signature, parent validity, or finality checks.
audit_result.attack_scenario: Attacker provides data column via RPC with valid KZG/inclusion proofs but invalid proposer signature. Node saves to storage, later serves it to peers via by_root RPC, violating the invariant that served sidecars must pass full gossip validation.

PROP-6a4369e9-inv-025.text: Sidecars must not be served for blocks failing gossip validation in by_root responses.
PROP-6a4369e9-inv-025.assertion: forall sidecar in resp: gossip_valid(sidecar.block) == true

audit_result.proof_trace: Property claims each blob produces exactly CELLS_PER_EXT_BLOB (128) cell-proof pairs. Code calls kzg.ComputeCells() without validating len(cells)==128, then constructs proofs array with exactly 128 elements. If library returns >128 cells, excess cells are silently ignored creating cells/proofs length mismatch.
audit_result.attack_scenario: If c-kzg-4844 library bug or version mismatch causes ComputeCells() to return ≠128 cells, code silently accepts mismatched CellsAndProofs struct, violating the spec invariant and potentially causing data column reconstruction failures.

PROP-57888860-inv-027.text: Each blob must produce exactly CELLS_PER_EXT_BLOB cell-proof pairs in cells_and_kzg_proofs construction.
